drills.name: Wall dink rally
drills.description: Continuous soft dinks against a practice wall with a net-height line; keep every contact out front with a stable face.
progressions: target box 6–12 in above the line

drills.name: Skinny singles
drills.description: Half-court singles (straight or crosscourt halves): full point play with less court to cover, concentrating reps on serve, return, third shot and kitchen play.
progressions: third shot must be a drop
regressions: serve-and-return only, replay the point after the 4th ball
drills.provenance: engineering placeholder — well-known public drill; NOT coach-validated
